items.question: How much does a computer repair cost?
items.answer: Every repair is different, so we don't quote a flat price before we've had a look. A cracked laptop screen costs less to fix than a failed hard drive, and a slow PC that just needs a clean-out costs less again. You get a straight quote before anything is booked in, and there's no charge for the diagnosis if you decide not to go ahead.

items.question: Do you repair laptops and desktop PCs?
items.answer: Yes, both. Laptops, desktops, all-in-ones, and Apple Macs.

items.question: Can you come to my home in Logan to fix my computer?
items.answer: Yes. Onsite visits across Logan Central, Woodridge, Loganlea, Springwood, Beenleigh, Browns Plains, Marsden and Shailer Park, plus remote support for software issues that don't need a technician on-site.

items.question: Can you replace my laptop battery?
items.answer: Yes, most laptop batteries can be swapped same day. See our laptop battery replacement page for common models and signs your battery needs replacing.

items.question: Is it cheaper to replace a hard drive or buy a new computer?
items.answer: Almost always cheaper to repair. A hard drive swap or upgrade runs a fraction of a new machine's price, and we'll tell you honestly if your computer's not worth fixing before we start.

items.question: Do you offer business IT services in Logan?
items.answer: Yes. Setup, upgrades, and ongoing support for small businesses, not just home users.
